sentences.en: With text we mean any communicative situation of significant length.
sentences.zh: 我们所说的文本是指任何具有重要意义的交流情境。

sentences.en: I tend to look at the pictures before reading the text.
sentences.zh: 我通常会在阅读课文之前先看图片。

sentences.en: He studied the original text of War and Peace.
sentences.zh: 他研究了《战争与和平》的原文。
